d.ko: A slow-burn folk farming horror. You bought an isolated farm to start a new life. Your peaceful routine is shattered when the former owner's terrible secrets rise from beneath the ground.
d.en: A slow-burn folk farming horror. You bought an isolated farm to start a new life. Your peaceful routine is shattered when the former owner's terrible secrets rise from beneath the ground.
d.zh: 你买下了一座与世隔绝的农场，准备开启新生活。然而，前房主埋藏在地下的可怕秘密逐渐浮出水面，打破了平静的日常。一场缓慢燃烧的乡村恐怖之旅就此展开。
